rows.ethical_framing: # gunnchos 7GC Field Console: Phone-First AI-RAN Measurement Kit **Umbrella research artifact** for an **IMT-2030-aligned / 6G-aligned** portfolio coupling AI-assisted O-RAN-style policy experiments with a **phone-first field console** for exploratory edge measurements. This is a **research prototype**, not commercial 6G, carrier-grade AI-RAN, or citywide deployment. ---

Notes: - One valid Pixel 6a calibration exists (privacy-safe reports committed); it is **calibration_only** and does **not** count toward the pilot. - Gate 2 system PASS does **not** imply clean-checkout reproduction, non-author reproduction, immutable release, or DOI/archive (those remain Gate 5/6). - ReadyGary is an **optional** PHY supporting study, not a flagship thesis repository.
